title: CHAPTER 6: MAHARASHTRA – GENERAL SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

blocks.content: 6.1 Scientific and Research Institutions in Maharashtra

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Maharashtra is home to premier scientific research institutions including BARC and TIFR.
Tarapur Atomic Power Station (TAPS) in Palghar district was India's first commercial nuclear power station.
Pune's Hinjawadi and Mumbai's SEEPZ are pivotal drivers of Maharashtra's booming IT sector.
The state's energy sector integrates thermal, hydro, nuclear, and growing renewable energy infrastructure.

cells: Trombay, Mumbai – India's premier nuclear research institute; established 1954
Mumbai – Advanced research in mathematics and natural sciences
Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER)
Pune – World's largest vaccine manufacturer by doses
Pune – Under ICMR; identified COVID-19 in India

blocks.content: CHAPTER 6: MAHARASHTRA – GENERAL SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

items: ISRO's Satish Dhawan Space Centre is in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh, but Maharashtra has key ISRO units.
ISRO Space Applications Centre – various units in Maharashtra
Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre – components manufactured here
Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre's unit – test facilities
Pune has IUCAA (Inter-University Centre for Astronomy and Astrophysics) – one of India's premier astronomy research institutes
Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (GMRT): Located at Khodad near Narayangaon, Pune district. It is the world's largest low-frequency radio telescope array.

cells: Tarapur, Palghar district; India's first nuclear power plant (1969); 4 units; 1400 MW capacity
Ratnagiri district (proposed); will be world's largest nuclear power park when completed; French technology (Areva/EDF EPR reactors); 9900 MW planned

items: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) is situated at Trombay, Mumbai.
Tarapur Atomic Power Station (TAPS) in Palghar is frequently asked as India's premier commercial nuclear power plant.
National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI) is located in Nagpur.

cells: Main electricity distribution company; popularly called Mahavitaran
Major hydro power; 1960 MW capacity; on Koyna River, Satara
Chandrapur (CTPS) – 2340 MW; Koradi (Nagpur) – 2200 MW; Khaparkheda (Nagpur); Nasik TPS; Bhusawal TPS; Parli TPS (Beed); Uran Gas Power
Maharashtra among top states for solar potential; Solapur and Osmanabad high solar zones

items: Pune: Second largest IT hub in Maharashtra; IT parks in Hinjewadi, Magarpatta, EON IT Park
Mumbai: Financial IT and financial tech (Fintech) hub; BKC (Bandra Kurla Complex)
Nagpur: MIHAN SEZ includes IT/ITES zone
Aurangabad: Auto-sector IT companies
Maharashtra Information Technology Corporation (MITC) – promotes IT in the state
MahaIT / Mahaonline – e-governance platform of Maharashtra
DigiLocker, Maharashtra Government – digital document delivery
